generations.revisedPrompt:
Create ONE standalone card-theme illustration. Subject: a willow twig stuck into a small mound of earth and sprouting fresh leaves, a die lying beside the mound
Style: Match the STYLE PLATE (reference image 1) exactly. High-resolution limited-colour screen-print illustration: bold, even dark petrol-ink outlines; broad flat colour planes; one hard-edged shadow plane per form; fine halftone dots only inside shaded planes; small crisp ivory highlights; light from the upper left. Objects are chunky, simplified and slightly toy-like, seen in three-quarter view from slightly above. Ceramic dice are rounded warm-ivory cubes with dark ink pips unless the subject asks for red or blue pips.
Colour roles: Warm ivory #F4E8CB for lit surfaces and dark petrol #173E40 for shadow planes, bases and dark parts carry most of the picture; ink #162629 for outlines and pips. Accents only, each on a few small areas: coral red #EC655D, cyan blue #55B6D9, amber gold #F3BA58 (amber only for coins, brass, rewards or a single highlight). No other hues, no gradients, no glow.
Composition: One cohesive subject group of at most three objects, centred on a square canvas; the subject spans roughly 70 to 95 percent of the canvas width without touching the edges, with even transparent margin on every side; the silhouette must stay readable at 64 pixels. Two or three short action strokes or a small spark near the upper left of the subject are allowed when they express the effect (usually cyan; coral or ink when the subject is red or dark).
Output: True transparent alpha background with no backdrop of any colour. A single finished illustration, not a sheet of variants.
Avoid: text, letters, numbers, labels, prices, card frames, UI elements, paper or coloured backdrop, ground scenery, checkerboard, a drop-shadow slab under the object, photorealism, 3D-render look, soft airbrush gradients, pixel art, neon glow, grunge, torn or burnt paper, human characters, expressive faces.
